resources.string: Detects which app is in the foreground so blocks can be enforced.

Control needs this to see which app you just opened, so it can put a block screen in front of it. With Hard mode on it also reads the text of Android settings screens, and only those, to notice an attempt to uninstall Control. It never reads other apps, never records what you type, and nothing leaves your device. Without it, blocks cannot be enforced on Android.
